text: Remember,{H2142} O Jehovah,{H3068} what is come upon us: Behold,{H7200} and see{H7200} our reproach.{H2781}
Our inheritance{H5159} is turned{H2015} unto strangers,{H2114} Our houses{H1004} unto aliens.{H5237}
